group_id_rule: Numeric prefix of the image filename; used as the cluster/resampling unit.
grouping_caveat: Group IDs are filename-prefix clusters in the provided prediction file. Their use as source groups is conditional on the dataset naming convention; source photographs and the original model checkpoint were not independently inspected here.

analysis.model: MobileNetV3Small (as documented in saved result artifacts; checkpoint not independently inspected)
analysis.warning: Analysis is conditional on saved labels/probabilities/predictions. It does not retrain or rerun model inference. Group bootstrap assumes filename-prefix group IDs are a defensible cluster unit; original source images and checkpoint were not independently verified.
